Il numero delle metastasi decide la tera:
The number of metastases determines the therapy: single or few → surgery or radiosurgery; more numerous → multiple radiosurgery, systemic therapy (in melanoma, immunotherapy also acts on the brain) or whole-brain radiotherapy. For this reason the report must count them all, with location and diameter.
The method: thin post-contrast 3D T1, scrolled from the vertex to the foramen magnum, including cerebellum and brainstem, also looking at the cortex and the vicinity of vessels. A vessel is followed in continuity on neighboring images; a metastasis is round and ends. Small lesions often have no edema.
Melanoma metastases are often hemorrhagic (hypointense on T2/T2*, sometimes hyperintense on non-contrast T1).
